messages:
Liam H: launching a 1% canary for redwood-v5q2 on /assist (route B). heads-up: this variant changes the prefetch / cache-key framing for long contexts. please watch behavioral signals.
Sofia P: noted. what signals are we using?
Liam H: temp safety window: rollback if dedupe_inc > 1.0% abs OR prefix_hash_mismatch_rate > 0.7% OR semantic_embed_drop > 1.0% OR p99_lat_delta > 160ms. also adding a prefetch_stability check: if cache_hit_seq_change > 2% on hot keys -> pause.
Ken M: good call. prefetched KV key reshaping in earlier quant kernels caused early-EOS and repeated tails in a past canary. add tokenized-length-histogram diff to the preflight.
deploy-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-v5q2 started at 1809994321 route=["/assist"] size=1% policy=gradual
Sofia P: starting a 2k replay + 5% shadow for 3h. i'll post replay diffs.
Ken M: adding a small A/B pair sample (300 pairs) for embed similarity check. also enabling prefix-consistency CI test for this job.
Sofia P: replay-job: replay-1809994321 started samples=2000
Sofia P: quick dashboard link: https://console.redwood/runs/1809994321 - p50/p95 stable, p99 +90ms, overall dedupe +0.4% abs.
Sofia P: replay-job: completed. summary: overall dedupe_inc=0.4% abs, hot-key slice (ticketing-docs) dedupe_inc=1.3% abs, prefix_hash_mismatch_ticketing=0.85% abs, cache_hit_seq_change(ticketing)=3.1%
Liam H: ticketing-docs hit prefix_mismatch + cache stability thresholds. those are hard signals for us. looks like prefetch key framing change is affecting cache alignment.
Ken M: pulling sample diffs. example: baseline keeps full clause; variant returns earlier EOS and repeats last clause. tokenized-length histogram shows a consistent -1 token mode shift for long contexts in ticketing slice.
Sofia P: given hard signals, i'm going to pause and rollback on route B. will attach replay artifacts and cache traces.
deploy-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-v5q2 on /assist at 1809994600 by @Sofia P
Liam H: opened RUNTIME ticket: prefetch-key framing + tokenization boundary with quant-kernel. assigning to @Ken M and @infra-quant. attaching replay and cache traces.
Ken M: follow-ups: 1) add prefetch_stability gate to default rollout rules for routes with KV caching, 2) CI preflight to compare cache-key hashes and tokenized-length histograms, 3) require 4h 5% shadow + replay pass before 5%->100% expansion for any variant touching prefetch logic.
Sofia P: will PR the config changes. also proposing a short-circuit rule: if prefix_hash_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for two consecutive 10m windows -> auto-pause.
Liam H: thanks team. note for onboarding docs: include a checklist item "does variant change prefetch/key framing?" so we avoid surprises.
